decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive cards such as Stifle and Standstill. The deck focuses on establishing a strong defense with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God, while also gaining card advantage through Fact or Fiction and Impulse. Additionally, it aims to limit the opponent's resources by utilizing Parallax Tide and Decree of Justice. The mana base includes utility lands like Dust Bowl and Mishra's Factory, providing additional versatility and options for the player.

The main focus of this deck is to set up a powerful combo using cards like Replenish, Opalescence, Parallax Tide, and Parallax Wave to control the board and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Frantic Search, Intuition, and Attunement to help find key pieces of the combo quickly. Additionally, cards like Swords to Plowshares, Stifle, and Seal of Cleansing provide removal and disruption to protect the combo. The mana base is designed to support the combo and ensure consistency in casting the necessary spells.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, supported by efficient mana acceleration and card advantage with cards like Sylvan Library. The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence and applying pressure to the opponent, while also having the ability to deal direct damage with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate. With a mix of creature threats and direct damage spells, this deck aims to win the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize and turn the game around.

The deck focuses on using Survival of the Fittest to tutor for creatures that provide value and disruption while controlling the game with cards like Sylvan Library and Rishadan Port. The deck aims to generate mana quickly with cards like Birds of Paradise and Gaea's Cradle, while also having a toolbox of creatures to deal with various threats. By utilizing a combination of card advantage, mana acceleration, and disruption, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a long game.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays using a variety of Goblin cards. The deck includes key Goblin creatures like Goblin Lackey, Goblin Matron, and Siege-Gang Commander, all of which can quickly build up a threatening board presence. In combination with cards like Goblin Warchief and Goblin Piledriver, this deck aims to deal damage swiftly and efficiently. With a mix of removal spells and mana acceleration, the deck seeks to maintain its momentum and put pressure on the opponent throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by countering spells, bouncing permanents, and drawing cards. By using cards like Counterspell, Mana Leak, and Stifle to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also having access to card advantage through Impulse, Fact or Fiction, and Accumulated Knowledge, the player aims to maintain a strong board presence with lands like Faerie Conclave and Mishra's Factory, while also having the potential to close out the game quickly with cards like Phyrexian Dreadnought. The deck relies heavily on playing a patient and strategic game to outlast the opponent.

The core idea of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption and removal spells like Duress, Cabal Therapy, and Smother. The deck also takes advantage of graveyard interactions with cards like Nether Spirit and Infestation','','');">Zombie Infestation, while maintaining board control with Mishra's Factory and Contamination. The inclusion of cards like Skeletal Scrying and Sickening Dreams provides card advantage and potential mass removal options, ensuring that the deck can outlast and outmaneuver opponents in a longer game.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures that can sacrifice themselves or others to trigger various effects and combo off. It aims to use cards like Survival of the Fittest to find key pieces like Academy Rector, which can then be sacrificed to search for powerful enchantments such as Pattern of Rebirth. These enchantments can then be used to bring out big creatures like Akroma, Angel of Wrath or create a loop with Karmic Guide and Goblin Bombardment for a win condition. The deck uses a mix of creatures and spells to create a versatile combo strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Fyndhorn Elves and Llanowar Elves to power out powerful creatures like Priest of Titania and Deranged Hermit. It also utilizes cards like Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Symbiote to untap creatures and generate even more mana. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, aggressive plays and large creatures like Multani's Acolyte and Masticore. Cards like Survival of the Fittest help ensure that the deck has the right creatures at the right time for maximum impact.

The focus of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through counterspells and bounce effects, while also generating card advantage with draw spells like Accumulated Knowledge. The key strategy is to maintain control of the game by countering threats and removing key permanents with cards like Chain of Vapor and Stifle. The deck also utilizes lands like Rishadan Port and Mishra's Factory to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, this Mono Blue Control deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through efficient control and resource management.

The deck focuses on quickly reducing the opponent's life total through a combination of low-cost, high-damage creatures and direct damage spells. The strategy involves playing aggressively from the start, utilizing efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic to apply pressure, while also punishing the opponent with burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Incinerate. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan. With a focus on quick and decisive damage, this deck is built to win games swiftly and decisively.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Stasis enchantment to lock down the opponent's resources while setting up a combo win condition. Using cards like Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Akroma, Angel of Wrath, the deck aims to control the game with counterspells and bounce spells while drawing through the deck with Gush and Impulse. The main win condition is to eventually overwhelm the opponent with creatures while they are unable to untap their lands due to Stasis, leading to victory through combat damage.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat that can win the game in a single turn. The deck utilizes a mix of countermagic and card draw spells to protect the combo pieces and find them quickly. This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition efficiently. With a streamlined strategy and precise play, this deck can outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through a swift and decisive combo.

The main focus of this deck is to establish board control and disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and efficient creatures. The strategy revolves around using cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress to strip key cards from the opponent's hand, while creatures like Blastoderm and Ravenous Baloth provide a solid clock and potential threat. Pernicious Deed acts as a reset button for the board, and Recurring Nightmare allows for recursion and value from creatures that have hit the graveyard. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through attrition and resource management.

This deck focuses on deploying aggressive creatures quickly and efficiently, while also utilizing disruptive spells to control the opponent's game plan. The deck makes use of powerful card draw engines like Sylvan Library and Accumulated Knowledge to maintain a steady stream of resources while applying pressure with creatures like Werebear and Nimble Mongoose. Counterspells and Meddling Mage are used to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Mox Diamond provides additional mana acceleration. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed, efficiency, and disruption.

This deck focuses on using Goblin Welder to swap artifacts in and out of the graveyard in order to control the game. By utilizing cards like Tangle Wire, Winter Orb, and Ensnaring Bridge, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while building up its own board presence. With powerful artifacts like Triskelion and Thopter Squadron, along with the ability to search for key pieces with Tinker, the deck can quickly shift gears and close out the game in its favor.
